Intro Body.value: At Alkimi, we are more than a lighting manufacturer. Based in New York, we bring more than fifty years of combined experience in architectural lighting design, sales, and product development to a single conviction: color quality is not a line on a specification sheet, it is the entire experience of a space. We design and produce Alkiline linear systems and Amalgam architectural fixtures for environments where light is treated as material rather than decoration.

Value 1 Text.value: Color science is the foundation. We measure across six dimensions rather than trusting a single average, and we test against the conditions light actually meets - surfaces, finishes, skin, and the eye of the person standing there.

Value 2 Text.value: We work alongside design practices from concept through installation — samples, photometrics, custom runs as drawings evolve. Long-standing supplier relationships let us build to order rather than to catalog. The specification improves when the manufacturer is in the room.

Value 3 Text.value: Kimi runs the company end to end: quoting, pricing, fabrication, purchasing, delivery. One system rather than stitched-together tools, because a promise about a date is only as good as what tracks it.

Service 1 Text.value: Photometric files, physical samples, and spec documentation delivered while your drawings are still moving. We would rather answer questions during design development than issue a credit after installation.

Service 2 Text.value: Opus resolves the administrative weight of a specification at once — pricing, lead times, driver sizing, power feeds, part numbers, submittal documents — so the paperwork matches the drawing without reconciliation.

Service 3 Text.value: Every order tracked through Opus from purchase to shipment, with documentation packets, QC photography, and warranty records held against the project rather than scattered across email threads.

Service 4 Text.value: Every run arrives labeled and mapped to a legend, with drawings and driver schedules the installer can follow without a phone call. Clean installs come from documentation, not improvisation.

Intro Body 2.value: Our name is deliberate — alchemy was transformation through precision. We work the same way across every part of the company: how a fixture is engineered, how color is measured, how a run is cut, how a promise is kept. Every quote and delivery moves through Opus, the system we built because no existing tool held that precision. The result is a company where nothing about light is left to approximation.
